fact_text: As a foreign (non-EU) resident leaving Spain for another country, you must request your removal (baja) from the Madrid municipal register (padrón) for change of residence, and you may obtain a certificate proving that de-registration.
evidence_quote: Cambio de residencia de extranjeros por traslado a otro país: Los extranjeros que trasladen su residencia a otro país deberán solicitar su baja por cambio de residencia y podrán obtener un certificado acreditativo de dicha baja.

fact_text: A foreigner's padrón de-registration for change of residence to another country is NOT retroactive: it is recorded with the date the request is filed (in person or via the electronic office), so the effective date is the day you apply, not the day you actually left.
evidence_quote: Las bajas por cambio de residencia de extranjeros a otro país no tienen carácter retroactivo, por lo que se graban con la fecha de la presentación de la solicitud presencial o la realizada a través de la SEDE electrónica.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Movers assume de-registration back-dates to their departure; in Madrid it takes effect only from the filing date, which can affect proof of when residence in Spain ended.

fact_text: If you stay on a Spanish employment contract while temporarily working in an EU/EEA/Switzerland country (e.g. Ireland), the posting is requested using form TA.300; the A1 (or E101) certificate itself is issued by the TGSS (Spanish Social Security Treasury) or its provincial offices, so the employer/worker does not fill it in beforehand.
evidence_quote: En este supuesto solo es necesario efectuar la solicitud con el modelo de solicitud TA.300. Nota: el formulario A1 o E101, según el Reglamento CE a aplicar, se expide por las Administraciones de la TGSS o en sus Direcciones Provinciales.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: A worker moving to Ireland but kept on a Spanish contract stays in the Spanish social-security system via the A1; many assume they must switch to Irish PRSI immediately.

fact_text: You can notify your temporary posting to work in another country and keep your Spanish Social Security registration active in Spain; through the same service you request the A1 certificate of applicable legislation for the destination country.
evidence_quote: Comunica tu desplazamiento temporal para trabajar en otros países y mantener tu alta en la Seguridad Social en España.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Posting keeps the mover affiliated in Spain rather than de-registering; this is the mechanism that avoids a Seguridad Social baja for a genuinely temporary move.

fact_text: If you are not in the census of businesses/professionals, you must report a change of your fiscal domicile to the Spanish tax authority (AEAT) using census form Modelo 030 within three months of the change; if the deadline for filing your income tax (Renta) return ends first, you report the change when you file that return.
evidence_quote: Puedes modificar tu domicilio fiscal y debes comunicarlo a la Administración tributaria que corresponda, en el plazo de tres meses desde que se produce el cambio si no formas parte del Censo de Empresarios, Profesionales y Retenedores, a través del modelo censal 030.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The Modelo 030 fiscal-domicile update is a distinct obligation from the padrón baja and has its own 3-month deadline tied to the Renta filing window.

fact_text: An employee who will become a non-resident (IRNR) taxpayer because their employer posts them abroad can notify the AEAT using communication form Modelo 247; the AEAT then issues a document for the employee to give the employer so that withholding is applied under the non-resident regime (IRNR).
evidence_quote: Los trabajadores por cuenta ajena que, no siendo contribuyentes por el Impuesto sobre la Renta de no Residentes, vayan a adquirir dicha condición como consecuencia de su desplazamiento al extranjero por su empleador, podrán comunicarlo a la Agencia Tributaria, mediante el modelo de comunicación 247.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Modelo 247 lets the worker switch to non-resident withholding early; it does not by itself prove the new tax residence, which must still be evidenced separately.

fact_text: Modelo 247 is filed at the AEAT office corresponding to your fiscal domicile before departure, and the filing window opens 30 days before the communicated date of leaving Spanish territory (up to the end of the period during which the AEAT-issued document has effect).
evidence_quote: Plazo de presentación: Desde los 30 días anteriores a la fecha de salida del territorio español que se haya comunicado y, como máximo, hasta el fin del plazo en que está previsto que se extiendan los efectos de los documentos expedidos por la Agencia Tributaria.

fact_text: Under Spanish domestic law you are treated as a Spanish tax resident if you spend more than 183 days of the calendar year in Spain (sporadic absences count unless you prove tax residence in another country); a change of residence does NOT split the tax period, so you are resident or non-resident for the whole calendar year.
evidence_quote: Una persona física será residente o no residente durante todo el año natural ya que el cambio de residencia no supone la interrupción del período impositivo.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Unlike Ireland's split-year treatment, Spain has no mid-year split for residence status, which is decisive for how the departure year is taxed and needs a treaty analysis.

fact_text: After becoming a non-resident, Modelo 210 is the self-assessment used to declare income obtained in Spain without a permanent establishment; you generally do NOT have to file it for income on which the IRNR withholding was already applied, except in specific cases (e.g. imputed income of urban real estate, or income paid by someone with no withholding obligation).
evidence_quote: No estarán obligados a presentar autoliquidación respecto de las rentas sobre las que se hubiese practicado la retención o efectuado el ingreso a cuenta del Impuesto a que se refiere el artículo 31 de la Ley del Impuesto

applies_to.non_obvious_note: A departing worker who keeps Spanish-source income (e.g. a rented Madrid flat) may still owe Modelo 210 filings as a non-resident even after leaving.
